images.title: Corners cross the mirror line
images.purpose: Show that each corner of a flipped square lands across the mirror line at the same height.
images.composition: One square centred on a vertical mirror line, with two level arrows, wide space around it.
images.exact_structure: One square, side 4 cm, corners A top left, B top right, C bottom right, D bottom left. One vertical dashed mirror line in grey #6B7280 through the exact middle. Left half filled teal #0072B2, right half filled amber #E69F00. Two horizontal curved arrows in reddish purple #CC79A7 crossing the line: one from A to B at the top, one from D to C at the bottom. Exactly 1 square, 1 mirror line, 2 arrows.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
an arrow that goes up or down instead of across
images.takeaway: Each corner lands across the mirror line at the same height.
images.description: A square split by a vertical dashed mirror line, teal on the left and amber on the right, with level arrows from A to B and from D to C crossing the line.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to follow corner A by finger across the mirror line and say where it lands.

image_decisions.why: The idea is a picture idea; one clean image carries it.
